info.title: LexFlow API
info.description:
REST API for the LexFlow Legal Platform.

**RBAC:** Pass `role` in the request header to identify the caller.
Accepted values: `client` | `lawyer` | `intern` | `firmadmin` | `superadmin`

role-auth.name: role
role-auth.description: User role for RBAC. Values: client | lawyer | intern | firmadmin | superadmin

firmId.description: Associated firm ID (for FIRMADMIN, LAWYER, INTERN roles)

role.description: Expected role for this sign-in attempt
User role (client, lawyer, intern, firmadmin, superadmin, user)
